description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI screen for voice interaction in an Android app, including microphone permissions, toggle controls, visualizations, and conversation display.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual voice conversation turn, including text, role, and streaming status.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: Enumeration for the roles in a conversation, such as User or Assistant.

methods.name: VoiceTabScreen
methods.description: Main composable function that renders the voice interaction UI, managing microphone state, permissions, conversation display, and controls.

methods.name: VoiceTurnBubble
methods.description: Displays an individual conversation turn in the chat, styled based on the role.

methods.name: VoiceThinkingBubble
methods.description: Displays a 'thinking' indicator while the assistant is generating a response.

methods.name: ThinkingDot
methods.description: Individual animated dot within the thinking indicator.

methods.name: hasRecordAudioPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to record audio.

methods.name: findActivity
methods.description: Traverses context wrappers to find the associated Activity instance.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the app's settings page for manual permission management.
